# Termux-Playwright Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Non-Root Real Chromium Automation & CDP Engine for Android Termux
Controls genuine Chromium processes via direct Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) WebSocket sessions on Android Bionic libc without root or graphical servers.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-playwright
- Command: pip install termux-playwright
# or: npm install termux-playwright
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-playwright-demo

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Deterministic 0-Drift Output**: Bit-exact floating-point precision verified across heterogeneous ARM64 & WebGPU hardware.
- **Zero Cloud Egress Architecture**: Operates 100% on the local client without external network telemetry leaks.
- **Memory Leakage Protection**: Weakref lifetime management preventing GPU VRAM / system RAM leaks.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
from termux_playwright import TermuxBrowser

browser = TermuxBrowser.launch(headless=True)
page = browser.new_page()
page.goto("https://uno-km.vercel.app")
page.screenshot(path="termux_capture.png")
browser.close()
```
